name: x_rules_multiball_lockout_2
description: rules mode, 2 balls: ball 0 from x_rules_sensor_C6, slot 1 from x_rules_sensor_BB. EP9-13 keep one sensor lockout per ball (ds:370e+2i, copied into ds:3719 around each ball's pixel scan and decremented per frame per slot); a lockout set by one ball's handler must not block the other ball's sensors. The port with a single lockout diverges at record 3 (ball.y, ball.yf, ball.vy).
